name: Commerce VNPay
description: VNPay (Vietnam) offsite-redirect payment gateway for Drupal Commerce.
project_description:
Payment gateway VNPAY-QR 
 

 This module for testing only 

 The payment gateway system meets the standards of the State Bank of Vietnam and international security standards PCI DSS 3.2.1 level 1, fulfilling stringent requirements for security and data processing procedures set forth by the International Security Standards Council. The system includes a firewall to protect the database and enforces strict information control.

 Diverse payment methods: 

 
 Payment via VNPAY-QR supported applications 
 QR code scanning payment 
 Payment via ATM - Domestic accounts 
 Payment via international cards 
 
 Document: VNPay
